pack.name: OWASP API Security Top 10
pack.description: API architecture security themes aligned to OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023) categories — authorization, authentication, resource limits, SSRF, inventory, and third-party API consumption. Thematic mapping only; not OWASP certification or penetration-test substitution.

rules.title: Object-level authorization enforced on every API route
rules.description: APIs exposing object identifiers must document authorization checks that bind the caller identity to the requested resource — not rely on obscurity of IDs alone.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document BOLA controls in governance.RequiredControls; tag API services with authz model (e.g., authz:object-level) in services[].Tags.

rules.title: Indirect object references validated server-side
rules.description: When clients supply resource keys or paths, architecture must show server-side ownership validation before data access — especially across multi-tenant boundaries.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe tenant scoping and ownership checks in governance.PolicyConstraints; enumerate datastores[] reached by API WritesTo/ReadsFrom edges.

frameworkMappings.theme: API1:2023 — Broken Object Level Authorization (indirect references)

rules.title: Horizontal privilege escalation paths documented
rules.description: APIs must document how peer-user access is prevented when object IDs are guessable or enumerable.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record horizontal-access test expectations in metadata.ChangeDescription; align API gateway policies in governance.RequiredControls.

frameworkMappings.theme: API1:2023 — Broken Object Level Authorization (horizontal access)

rules.title: API authentication mechanism documented
rules.description: Each public or partner API surface must document the authentication scheme (OAuth2, mTLS, API keys with rotation) and token validation boundaries.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag auth scheme on services[].Tags; document token issuer and validation in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Short-lived credentials and token rotation
rules.description: Long-lived API keys or refresh tokens without rotation themes increase breach blast radius — architecture should document expiry and revocation.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document token TTL and rotation in governance.PolicyConstraints; prefer managed identity or OAuth over static keys in services[].RequiredControls.

rules.title: Machine-to-machine auth separated from user sessions
rules.description: Service accounts and client-credentials flows must be distinguished from end-user sessions with separate scopes and audit paths.
rules.remediationGuidance: Enumerate M2M clients in services[]; document scope boundaries in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Response filtering prevents excessive object exposure
rules.description: APIs must document field-level filtering so clients cannot read or modify object properties beyond their authorization — mass assignment and over-exposure themes.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe response schema filtering and write guards in governance.PolicyConstraints; tag sensitive fields in datastores[].Tags.

frameworkMappings.theme: API3:2023 — Broken Object Property Level Authorization

rules.title: Mass assignment protections on write endpoints
rules.description: PATCH/PUT handlers must document allow-lists for mutable properties — especially role, ownership, or billing fields.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record writable-field allow lists in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.RequiredControls.

frameworkMappings.theme: API3:2023 — Broken Object Property Level Authorization (mass assignment)

rules.title: Rate limiting and throttling documented
rules.description: API gateways or services must document per-client rate limits to prevent abuse and resource exhaustion.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document rate-limit tiers in governance.PolicyConstraints; reference API Management or gateway services in services[].Tags.

rules.title: Pagination and query size limits
rules.description: List and search endpoints must document maximum page sizes and query complexity limits to prevent expensive unbounded reads.
rules.remediationGuidance: Specify pagination defaults and caps in governance.PolicyConstraints; note datastore query cost in metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Upload and payload size limits
rules.description: File upload and large JSON endpoints must document size limits and async processing to prevent DoS via payloads.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document max payload sizes in governance.PolicyConstraints; tag upload services in services[].Tags.

rules.title: Function-level authorization on administrative APIs
rules.description: Admin, debug, and internal-only API operations must be separately authorized — not gated only by URL obscurity or network location.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag admin API surfaces in services[].Tags; document role requirements in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: HTTP method and route authorization matrix
rules.description: Architecture should document which roles may invoke which HTTP methods on sensitive routes — not assume uniform bearer-token access.
rules.remediationGuidance: Summarize route/method RBAC in metadata.ChangeDescription; align with API gateway policy exports when available.

frameworkMappings.theme: API5:2023 — Broken Function Level Authorization (method matrix)

rules.title: Internal APIs not exposed via public ingress
rules.description: Internal function-level APIs must document private networking, mTLS, or zero-trust service mesh boundaries — not public load balancers.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document ingress separation in governance.PolicyConstraints; correlate private endpoints from resources.json when extractor inventory exists.

frameworkMappings.theme: API5:2023 — Broken Function Level Authorization (network exposure)

rules.title: Sensitive business flows protected against automation abuse
rules.description: High-value flows (payments, password reset, account recovery) must document anti-automation controls — step-up auth, CAPTCHA, velocity checks.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag sensitive flows in services[].Purpose; document abuse controls in governance.RequiredControls.

frameworkMappings.theme: API6:2023 — Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows

rules.title: Workflow step-up authentication documented
rules.description: Multi-step transactions that change security posture (wire transfer, privilege elevation) should document re-authentication or approval gates.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe step-up patterns in governance.PolicyConstraints and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: SSRF protections on outbound API integrations
rules.description: Services that fetch user-supplied URLs or callbacks must document allow-lists, DNS pinning, or egress controls to prevent server-side request forgery.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document egress filtering in governance.PolicyConstraints; tag webhook/callback services in services[].Tags.

rules.title: Metadata service and cloud credential SSRF themes
rules.description: Workloads parsing external URLs must document blocking of link-local and cloud metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254 themes) via egress policy.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record metadata endpoint block expectations in governance.RequiredControls; align with NSG/UDR narratives from extractor inventory.

rules.title: API security headers and TLS configuration
rules.description: Public APIs must document TLS versions, HSTS, and security header posture — not default framework settings without review.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document TLS and header policy in governance.PolicyConstraints; reference API gateway or App Service configuration in services[].Tags.

rules.title: Debug and verbose error modes disabled in production
rules.description: Production API stacks must document that debug endpoints, stack traces, and verbose errors are disabled or restricted to break-glass roles.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag environment class on services[].Tags; document error-handling policy in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: CORS and cross-origin policy documented
rules.description: Browser-facing APIs must document CORS allow-lists — wildcard origins with credentials are a common misconfiguration theme.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record CORS policy in governance.PolicyConstraints; note public vs partner origin lists in metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Complete API inventory maintained
rules.description: Architecture must enumerate all API surfaces (public, partner, internal, legacy) — shadow APIs and forgotten endpoints are a common gap.
rules.remediationGuidance: List API services in services[] with exposure class tags; reconcile with API gateway or App Service inventory from resources.json.

rules.title: API versioning and deprecation lifecycle
rules.description: Deprecated API versions must document sunset dates and client migration paths — not indefinite parallel unsupported versions.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document version policy in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.PolicyConstraints; tag legacy versions in services[].Tags.

rules.title: Third-party API responses validated and sanitized
rules.description: When consuming external APIs, architecture must document schema validation, timeout, and trust boundaries — not pass-through of untrusted payloads.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document validation and timeout policy in governance.PolicyConstraints; enumerate external API dependencies on WritesTo edges.

rules.title: Third-party API credential isolation
rules.description: Credentials for upstream APIs must be scoped per integration and stored in managed secret stores — not shared across services.
rules.remediationGuidance: Require Key Vault or equivalent on external integration services; document scope in services[].RequiredControls.

frameworkMappings.theme: API10:2023 — Unsafe Consumption of APIs (credential scope)

rules.title: Circuit breakers and fallback for upstream APIs
rules.description: Critical upstream dependencies should document circuit breaker, retry, and degraded-mode behavior when third-party APIs fail or slow.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe resilience patterns in services[].Purpose and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: API schema and contract documentation published
rules.description: OpenAPI or equivalent contracts should be version-controlled and linked to deployed services — supporting inventory and consumer alignment.
rules.remediationGuidance: Reference contract repository or portal in metadata.ChangeDescription; tag contract-backed services in services[].Tags.

rules.title: API security testing in CI/CD pipeline
rules.description: Architecture should document SAST/DAST or API-specific security tests in the deployment path before production promotion.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document security test gates in governance.PolicyConstraints; tag CI/CD services in services[].Tags.
